Function totalVolume(root) Dim total Dim volumes total = 0 Set volumes = root.selectNodes("portfolio/stock/volume")
For Each node in volumes total = total + node.nodeTypedValue Next
totalVolume = formatNumber(total, "0") & " million shares" End Function
Function averageChange(root) Dim total Dim count Dim formatedNumber total = 0
Set percents = root.selectNodes("portfolio/stock/percent") count = percents.length
For Each node In percents total = total + node.nodeTypedValue Next
formatedNumber = formatNumber(total/count, "1") averageChange = formatedNumber & "%" End Function
